CASE( TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode),
'EUR',
/*Euros*/
(IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2026, 1, 1), 1.099200,

IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2025, 1, 1), 1.149700,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2023, 10, 1), 1.1250,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2022, 10, 1), 1.1692,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2021, 10, 1), 1.165,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2020, 10, 1), 1.100,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2020, 1, 1), 1.107,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2019, 1, 1), 1.120,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2018, 1, 1), 1.1237,
1.1070)))))))))),

'USD',

/*Dollars*/
(IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2026, 1, 1), 1.330000,

IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2025, 1, 1), 1.268800,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2023, 10, 1), 1.2470,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2022, 10, 1), 1.3067,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c>= DATE(2021, 10, 1), 1.3690,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2020, 10, 1), 1.2800,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2020, 1, 1), 1.2700,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2019, 1, 1), 1.3401,
IF(Opportunity_Close_Date__c> DATE(2018, 1, 1), 1.3162,
1.2700)))))))))),

1)
